params._about: Solo-tuned AI stats for the Skyglass treasure hunts (engine/hunts.ts). Keys are live AI ids; pools = poolsMultiplier, rows = innate +100% damage-given rows (each capped at 100 by the engine, rows multiply), stats = statsMultiplier where changed from live. Crown Archivist (Archive alarm guard) and the Called to the Archive summon (Crown Stonebound: echoHp, echoPower) per RUL-2026-10-28-013.
params._final_pass: fable/skyglass-final-sim: Watch Captain 2/4 -> 2.5/1 + 10% givenDown (the phase-1 duel killed a solo player by round 3-9: 7/40); Foundry Warden 2.5/1 -> 3.5/1 (97.5% -> target 80%); Cache Sentinel 3/3 -> 3/4 (RUL-2026-10-28-021: boss ~20% HP); echoPower 60 -> 40 (RUL-2026-10-28-026 item 3).
params._rul060: RUL-2026-10-30-060 item 1: The Captain's solo pools 2.5 -> 3 (1 damage row and 10% damage given down unchanged). Otherwise identical to overrides/hunts.params.json (final pass).

record.name: Unbroken Command
record.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
record.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

record.name: Unraveling Strike
record.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

record.name: Rigging Snare
record.description: Seal-threaded rigging lashes the target and briefly pins them in place.
record.battleDescription: %user lashes seal-threaded rigging at %target, the lines snapping shut around their footing.

record.name: Twin Kunai
record.description: Two quick projectiles in succession.
record.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

record.name: Opening Strike
record.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
record.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

record.name: Quick Strike
record.description: A fast, reliable attack.
record.battleDescription: %user darts in with a compact strike, quick as a swallow, aimed at an opening in %target's guard. The welt it leaves flares hot under every blow that follows, and the rush of the hit sharpens %user's own attacks.

record.name: Dispelling Wave
record.description: Shared pool record B32. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user forms the Ram seal and releases a cold pulse of chakra across the field. Every enhancement wrapped around %target and those beside them is stripped away in an instant.

record.name: Split Image
record.description: Shared pool record B06. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user weaves the Ram seal and presses chakra into the earth at their side. A second %user rises from it, identical down to the dust on their tabi, and steps into the fight.

record.name: Battle Trance
record.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
record.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

record.name: Shuriken Storm
record.description: A stream of light projectiles.
record.battleDescription: %user fans a handful of shuriken between their fingers and loosens them in rapid succession. They whistle past %target's guard from every angle and leave deep cuts that keep bleeding.

record.name: Keelbind
record.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
record.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

record.name: Sovereign Fetters
record.description: Shared pool record B16. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user hurls chains of chakra that wrap %target from shoulder to ankle and crush tight. The bindings leave them stunned and seal away their bloodline while the links hold.

record.name: Second Wind
record.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

record.name: Counter Stance
record.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
record.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

record.name: Stoneward
record.description: Shared pool record EE03. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user sets their feet and draws a crust of earth chakra across their skin like fired clay. Blows that land on them lose much of their force.

record.name: Stolen Form
record.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

record.name: Final Command
record.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
record.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

record.name: Weakening Strike
record.description: Shared pool record S27. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

record.name: Windlash Focus
record.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
record.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

record.name: Suppression Writ
record.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
record.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

record.name: Erupting Ground
record.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off. (Skyglass copy: damage hits enemies only.)

record.name: Adamantine Fortress
record.description: A defensive earth-style jutsu that raises barriers to protect the user and reduce damage taken.
record.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions.
